approved_by_user: 2026-10-01: user approved running this phase on a new branch, after confirming that fine-tuning our own scratch-trained model is allowed (the Track 01 ban is on fine-tuning previously existing models).
objective: Competition benchmark performance (HellaSwag, ARC-Easy, PIQA, WinoGrande acc; WikiText-103 perplexity) by fine-tuning V2 on the four benchmarks' TRAIN splits in the exact pinned-harness scoring format.
hypothesis: Supervised multiple-choice training on each benchmark's own training split raises held-out accuracy (fine-tuned GPT-1-size models: HellaSwag 41.7, PIQA 69.2), while 30% replay of V2 pretraining text holds raw-language quality.
not_a_repeat: V1 post-training (A01-A08) excluded all benchmark text from SFT data and used instruction formats; A09's choice-loss arm never trained. This phase trains on the benchmarks' own train splits in the harness's raw scoring format, starting from V2, with a choice-level loss.

data.sources: Train splits at pinned revisions: Rowan/hellaswag 218ec52e, allenai/ai2_arc ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge 210d026f, ybisk/piqa ba2f7a49 (hash-checked parquet), allenai/winogrande winogrande_xl 01e74176.
data.split: V2's existing hash split (scglm_v2.benchmarks.is_development, 20%). The held-out 20% is the selection panel and is never trained on. Counts must equal v2/data/rich_v1/benchmarks/report.json or preparation fails.
data.decontamination: Training items whose context matches an official evaluation item (normalized exact match or any shared 13-word sequence) are dropped. Official splits are read as text only for this check.
data.format: scglm_v2.task_format: verified identical to all 15,523 recorded official harness requests, and scorer log-likelihoods within 1e-4 of the recorded V2 values (50 items per task).

recipe.loss: 0.7 * (choice_ce + 0.5 * gold_lm) + 0.3 * replay_lm; candidate score = summed continuation log-likelihood (no added parameters)
recipe.optimizer: AdamW betas (0.9, 0.95), eps 1e-8, weight decay 0.1 on matrices, clip 1.0, fresh state
recipe.schedule: 32 questions + 8 replay sequences (1,024 tokens) per update; 3 epochs; warmup 0.2% of updates; linear decay to 0 at the end of epoch 3 (GPT-1 fine-tuning settings)
recipe.candidates: exports at the end of each epoch of each arm (6); epoch 1-2 exports are prefixes of the 3-epoch schedule

compute_limits.gpu: GPU 0 (GPU-78815613-815b-f56b-27c0-6bc239e093fc) only; GPU 1 belongs to another team

selection_rule.data: development only: held-out 20% of benchmark train items (harness format) and the corpus selection panels
selection_rule.rule: Among candidates whose Wikipedia selection bits/byte is at most +0.01 worse than V2's, take the highest four-task proxy mean acc. Select it only if that mean is at least +1.0 point above V2's on the same scorer; otherwise keep V2.
selection_rule.why_1_point: The held-out items come from the same pool as the training items, so development gains will overstate official gains.
selection_rule.record: v2/phases/task_tune/selection.json, frozen before any official score of a task-tuned model

official_evaluation: Pinned runner (scripts/run_final_evaluation.py, configs/evaluation.json) once on the selected candidate. If V2 is retained, the best eligible candidate is still evaluated once and reported as not selected.
reporting: Report V2 base and the task-tuned model side by side, labelled 'fine-tuned on the benchmarks' training splits'. V2's official scores were observed before this phase.

commands.train: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=src python -m scglm_v2.task_tune train --config v2/phases/task_tune/config.json --arm <lr2e-5_r0.5|lr2e-5_r0.7|lr1e-5_r0.5>
commands.select: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONPATH=src python -m scglm_v2.task_select --config v2/phases/task_tune/config.json --out v2/phases/task_tune/selection.json
commands.resume: No resume: each arm runs in about 20 minutes. A failed arm is recorded and rerun into a new run_dir.
commands.chain: GPU=0 bash scripts/run_task_tune.sh   (tmux gibc-v2-task-tune): 3 arms concurrently -> task_select -> one official evaluation

amendment_1_before_launch.finding: The registered recipe (raw summed-log-likelihood choice loss, LR 6.25e-5, replay 0.3) damaged raw-language fit in 600-update smoke runs (Wikipedia bits/byte +0.081, gold-sequence loss 3.18 -> ~3.7-4.0) for +0.9 points on unseen training items. Temperature 10 in the choice softmax (argmax unchanged) gave +2.9 points but still +0.044 bits/byte at LR 6.25e-5. LR 1e-5 to 2e-5 with replay 0.5 gave +1.6 to +2.0 points at +0.006 to +0.012 bits/byte (peak LR, before decay).
amendment_1_before_launch.unchanged: Data, split, decontamination, parent, the selection rule (+1.0 point proxy gain, Wikipedia bits/byte <= +0.01) and the official-evaluation plan. No training run had started; the selection panel and official data were not used.
amendment_1_before_launch.compute_limits: max_gpu_hours_total stays 4; the three arms run concurrently on GPU 0
amendment_1_before_launch.official_evaluation: If V2 is kept and no candidate passes the Wikipedia guard, the highest-proxy candidate is evaluated once and reported as guard-failed, not selected.
